title: Complete interactive browser QA and capture real screenshots
problem: Exercise creation, all commands, blocked closure, save/reload, reopens, evidence withdrawal, stale versions, export and print. Check desktop and 390px layouts, keyboard focus and console.
acceptance: Record browser/version and results; fix failures; commit actual fictional-data screenshots. Do not replace this with API-only testing.

title: Retire disproven hypotheses without erasing history
problem: Every proposed cause currently must be verified and actioned, making a disproven hypothesis hard to retain accurately.
acceptance: Add ruled-out/superseded state with actor, rationale and accepted disconfirming evidence. Preserve history. Require an active verified occurrence and escape cause. Test downstream invalidation.

title: Revise action plans with explicit invalidation
problem: Action plans currently cannot be corrected through a supported revision command.
acceptance: Allow owner/date corrections and controlled changes to cause, deliverable or effectiveness plan. Invalidate implementation/results when technical changes affect prior proof. Preserve earlier snapshots and test stale revisions.

title: Add validated export restore and schema migrations
problem: JSON export can be inspected but cannot yet be restored through the app.
acceptance: Validate format, schema, record sizes, referential integrity, chain and case revisions before writes. Reject malformed or partial files atomically. Add round-trip and rollback tests; document backup compatibility.

title: Preserve source evidence attachments safely
problem: Text references do not retain source bytes, limiting review and traceability.
acceptance: Content hashes, explicit size/type limits, safe file names, no executable rendering, authenticated download policy for future server mode, export/backup inclusion and tests for traversal/oversize.

title: Design authenticated team deployment before enabling network hosting
problem: Current operator names are self-reported and the HTTP service is loopback-only.
acceptance: Threat model first. Define identities, roles, per-command authorization, transport, CSRF, session handling, backup and audit trust anchor. Add cross-user and concurrency tests. Keep loopback default until reviewed.
